item_reviews.comment: Zephyr: 72.2 vs 61.3/58.9 (SGD); 76.0 vs 69.9/65.8 (Clinc). Supported; no significance test.
Llama3: 72.4 vs 68.7/67.4; 76.9 vs 73.8/71.4; highest means in T1. Supported.
ChatGPT ZeroGen 60.2/71.3 is below Method M's 72.2/72.4 and 76.0/76.9.
Gains are 7.2, 4.9, 2.7, 3.1 points, all marked ** in the one-sided paired t-tests.
The package notes no T1 significance test and no exact p-values, statistics, or pairing unit for T2.

missing_core_findings.description: Without fine-tuning, the rewriter gives little or no gain over directly generated utterances. At 1x, NFT is below ZeroGen for SGD/Llama3 (67.5 vs 68.7) and ties it on Clinc150/Llama3 (73.8). It is above ZeroGen for Zephyr (65.0 vs 61.3; 73.3 vs 69.9). So most of the Llama3 gain depends on fine-tuning, while the Zephyr gain is partly retained.
At 2x data volume, the fine-tuned rewriter again beats NFT in all four settings (marked **). Fine-tuned accuracy is stable or rises slightly, while NFT is mixed (e.g., SGD/Zephyr falls to 62.9).
